svg.aria-label: Animation of light travelling through the light guide (side view)
svg.text: What happens to diffuse light in the guide
Side view, true proportions. A point on the entrance face emits Lambertian light: 8 of 44 rays reach the PMT; the rest steepen on the narrowing cone and turn back.
turned back, leaves by the entrance
Every polyline is a real ray traced with the fitted wall (source at x = -3 mm, y = +2 mm from the entrance centre), projected on the y–z plane, so skew rays appear not to touch
